code:
Theater version:
  "We deployed micro-segmentation." (shipped)

Real version:
  January: compromised account reaches 40 systems
  June:    compromised account reaches 3 systems
           (same account, same privileges,
            measured after rollout)
caption: The only acceptable proof of a roadmap item is a before/after access picture, not a shipped/not-shipped checkbox.
